name: JG_FSCL_LN_DTLS_ATRB_EXT_ALL
description: This table contains additional transaction line details level attributes required for generating fiscal document. These attributes are populated through the UI component provided by Fiscal Document Generation (FDG). For inbound fiscal document, this table is populated by the FDG process once the document is successfully validated.

columns.name: DOC_EXT_LINE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Document extension line detail identifier.

columns.name: DOC_EXT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Document extension line identifier.

columns.name: DOC_EXT_HDR_ID
columns.description: Document extension header identifier.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: System-generated identification number of a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Transaction line detail identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
